items.html: And therefore it did not say 'the three Sefirot nest in the Throne' but only 'Ima', for she alone is Tevuna, who spreads within ZA of Atzilut and illuminates in Beriah, and she alone nests in the Throne. For the three Sefirot do not spread, only that she receives illumination from them, and by their power she nests in the Throne. And from Tevuna alone are the Mochin of her children, within whom she spreads in the secret of Ohr Pnimi (inner lights), internal Mochin, and squats upon them in the secret of the Mochin of Ohr Makif, in the secret that she is called the green line that surrounds the world, ZON.
